observations.body: The LORD takes of the Spirit on Moses and places it on seventy elders, who prophesy; Eldad and Medad also prophesy, and Moses wishes all the LORD’s people were prophets.
observations.label: The Spirit rests on elders and Moses voices a wider wish

payload.posture: Read Numbers 11:24–30 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the LORD takes of the Spirit on Moses and places it on seventy elders, who prophesy; Eldad and Medad also prophesy, and Moses wishes all the LORD’s people were prophets. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: The Spirit rests on elders and Moses voices a wider wish
